data.one_liner: Programmatically change status bar and navigation bar colors in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: This plugin allows developers to dynamically change or retrieve the color and foreground brightness (white or dark) of the device's status bar and navigation bar programmatically on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to imperatively change the status bar or navigation bar color based on the current screen or theme.
You need to control the foreground icon/text brightness of the status bar or navigation bar.
avoid_when: You prefer using Flutter's built-in SystemChrome configurations for status bars (though this plugin allows fetching and more direct color modifications).
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS.
strengths: Supports getting and setting both status bar and navigation bar colors.
Provides helper functions like useWhiteForeground to determine contrast.
Supports Android v2 embedding and null-safety.
weaknesses: Foreground brightness may sometimes revert after app lifecycle changes, requiring manual handling via WidgetsBindingObserver.
Limited to Android and iOS platforms.
data.setup_notes: No extra permissions or configuration required beyond standard Flutter plugin integration.
